Internet Speed Meter protocol implementation notice

The NDT7 message flow in NetworkTools is based on Measurement Lab's
ndt7-client-android reference implementation:
https://github.com/m-lab/ndt7-client-android

NetworkTools modifies the reference design to use current app architecture,
bounded parsing and buffering, Android Network binding, explicit cancellation,
local consent/rate limits, and sanitized result persistence.
